summary: Jobs and their runs along one time axis, in a box on the card: a legend of the states the runs show, a ruler of ticks that fit the width on the time zone's clock, and a lane per job, its name and a detail line at the start and its runs where they fell, each a mark in its state's color (a bar as long as it took when it has an end), runs still to come hollow, a line at the current time across every lane. A lane is chosen by a press on its name or anywhere in its track, drawn raised; with onShift the chosen lane's upcoming runs drag sideways as one, snapped, a card at the pointer saying how far, and the arrow keys move them from the keyboard. The runs stay where they are until the app moves them. A total lane, such as how many run at once, closes the list.

anatomy.box: The whole timeline: a box on the card, edged in border, rounded by radius-surface, its text the body role. It fills its container's width and is as tall as its lanes.
anatomy.legend: A strip over the ruler, drawn when the runs show a state, a run is upcoming or a lane can be shifted: an entry per state, words.scheduled after them when a run is upcoming, and words.hint at its end while the chosen lane can be shifted (from 640 wide). Ruled under. legend false leaves it out.
anatomy.legendEntry: One state in the legend: its dot (8, the state's color; Scheduled's hollow in muted-foreground) and the status map's label for it.
anatomy.hint: words.hint at the legend's end while the chosen lane's upcoming runs can be shifted; left out below 640.
anatomy.axis: The ruler: a row as tall as axisHeight, the names' column empty at its start, the ticks' labels along the rest, ruled under.
anatomy.tick: A tick's label, centered on its time: the day (Nov 17) for a tick at the zone's midnight or a step of a day or more, else the time (14:00) on a 24-hour clock. A tick within 2 percent of either end, or within nowRoom of the current time's label, draws no label.
anatomy.gridLine: A tick's line, 1 wide, down every lane.
anatomy.nowLine: The current time's line, 1 wide, down every lane and over the grid lines; drawn while now is within the axis.
anatomy.nowLabel: words.now on the ruler, centered on the current time, in capitals: a small primary tab over the tick labels.
anatomy.lane: One job's row: its name at the start and its track after it, ruled under (the last lane not). The chosen lane is washed accent; a total lane is ruled over in border-strong.
anatomy.name: The lane's name and detail, nameWidth wide (nameWidthNarrow below 640), padded 12 across and 8 down, a 2 wide start edge that the chosen lane draws in primary. With onSelect it is a button that chooses the lane, the keyboard's way to it; a total lane's is not.
anatomy.laneName: The name, in the code face at weight 500, cut short with an ellipsis; a total lane's in the body face at 600.
anatomy.laneDetail: The line under the name (detail): its state or what it holds, cut short.
anatomy.track: The rest of the lane, at least laneMinHeight tall, holding the grid lines, the now line and the runs. A press anywhere in another lane's track chooses that lane, as its name does.
anatomy.run: A run where it fell: a mark at its start (4 wide) or a bar from its start to its end (at least 4), 16 tall, centered in the track, in its state's color; titled with its state and when (Nov 17, 14:00). A run after now is upcoming and drawn hollow. A run wholly outside the axis is not drawn.
anatomy.ghost: While a drag carries the upcoming runs, each one's place before the drag: a dashed outline as large as a mark.
anatomy.handle: The chosen lane's upcoming runs as one thing to drag, drawn only while onShift is given and the chosen lane has upcoming runs: a dashed primary box from the current time (or the first upcoming run) to the last upcoming run and handlePast beyond it, inset 4 from the track's top and bottom, a grip at its start. Named words.upcoming; a tab stop.
anatomy.grip: The handle's grip icon, 14, 2 in from its start, centered down it.
anatomy.card: While a pointer drags the handle: words.by with how far the runs move, on a card that follows the pointer, cardOffset right of and below it.

lanes.does: The lanes in order: { id, name, label?, detail?, runs, total? }; label is the name as text for a screen reader and the words, the name itself when that is text.

runs.does: A lane's runs: { id, at, end?, status? }, times as ISO 8601 or ms since the epoch. A run without end is a mark at its start; status is a state the status map knows.

now.does: The current time, drawn as a line; runs after it are upcoming. Left out, nothing is upcoming and nothing shifts.

selected.does: The lane chosen, drawn raised; its upcoming runs are what onShift moves. A total lane is never chosen.

onSelect.does: Hears the lane pressed, by its name or its track. Without it no lane is a button and no track takes a press.

onShift.does: Hears { lane, by } once the chosen lane's upcoming runs are dragged sideways, or moved with the arrow keys; by in ms, later above zero, never 0. The runs stay where they are until the app moves them.

snap.does: The step a shift snaps to, in ms; a quarter of the ticks' step when left out.

legend.does: The states the legend names, in order, with Scheduled after them; by default the states the runs up to now show, in the order they first appear. false leaves the legend out.

timeZone.does: The IANA time zone the ticks and times are written in, and whose midnights a step of a day lands on; the system's own when left out.

locale.does: The locale the ticks and times are written in.

name.note: nameWidth wide, nameWidthNarrow below 640; the start edge 2 wide.

track.note: At least: a lane is as tall as its name and detail when they need more.

run.note: A mark's width; a bar is as long as the run took, at least 4.

nameWidth.note: The names' column from 640 wide, on the ruler's row too, so the ticks line up with the runs.

tickRoom.note: The least room a tick's label takes: the step is the finest of 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 1d, 2d, 3d, 7d and 14d that puts no more than the width / 64 ticks on the axis (at least 2); 640 wide until the axis is measured.

nowRoom.note: A tick's label within this many px of the current time's draws none, so the two never overlap.

handleInset.note: The handle's room from the track's top and bottom.

handlePast.note: How far the handle reaches past the last upcoming run.

cardOffset.note: How far right of and below the pointer the card stands.

dragFrom.note: How far a mouse or pen moves pressed before the handle drags; a touch drags after a 300 ms hold that moves less than 8.

rest.means: Drawn: the legend, the ruler and every lane, no lane chosen.

hover.means: The pointer is over another lane's name or track: the name on muted, the track on muted at half strength; the handle on primary at 10 percent.
hover.reached: the pointer, where a press would choose the lane or drag the runs

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a lane's name or the handle: the frame's focus outline, drawn its offset inside the box.

selected.means: The chosen lane: washed accent, its name's start edge in primary, its name keeping the accent under the pointer, and no press on its track.

total.means: A lane that adds up the others: ruled over in border-strong, its name in the body face at 600, never a button and never chosen.

upcoming.means: A run after now: hollow, edged in muted-foreground; the ones of the chosen lane are what the handle moves.

dragging.means: A pointer carries the chosen lane's upcoming runs: they and the handle are drawn where the shift puts them, snapped, never before now; a ghost stands at each one's place before the drag, and the card says how far. Let go, onShift hears the shift unless it is 0; Escape or a lost pointer puts them back.
dragging.reached: a press on the handle moved past dragFrom

narrow.means: Below 640 the names' column is nameWidthNarrow and the hint is left out.

rest.note: The dot is the state's color from the status map; Scheduled's is hollow, edged in muted-foreground.
In the code face, on one line.
In the code face, in capitals, on a 16 line.
The last lane draws no rule; the box's edge closes it.

total.note: Over the lane, besides the rule under the lane before it.

rest.note: A 2 wide start edge, drawn only when chosen; the lane's ground shows through.
No ground of its own: the lane's shows.
Ground: the run's state's color from the status map (status-succeeded, status-failed, ...), which the app's StatusProvider may change at run time; an unknown state the map's fallback.
elevation-pop under it; the drag engine's card for a compact copy.

keyboard.does: Reaches each lane's name, in order, then the chosen lane's handle after its name.
Shifts the chosen lane's upcoming runs a snap earlier or later; onShift hears it. A shift that would put the first upcoming run at or before now does nothing.
Shifts them a tick's step earlier or later, held to now as the arrows are.
Puts the runs back where they were and ends the drag.

words.hint: Drag the selected job's upcoming runs to shift them

appText.lanes: Each lane's name, label and detail.
appText.states: The legend's labels and the runs' titles name each state by the status map's label for it.

sokkel-ui: The axis is measured with a ResizeObserver; the ticks fit 640 until it is.

The drag runs on the library's one drag engine (dnd-kit, DragDrop), whose layer (run-timeline-drag) is fetched the first time a timeline with onShift is drawn; until then the handle is drawn and takes the arrow keys but no drag. A drop lands on no target: the timeline says the shift itself.
The shift is said to a screen reader (words.shifted, polite); the handle names its keys in aria-keyshortcuts, the name its state in aria-pressed.
A tick's label and a time are written with Intl.DateTimeFormat in locale and timeZone; a shift's amount by formatShift: signed, in days, hours and minutes, 0m when nothing.
The card's words follow the drag through a store, as the drag engine draws the card once.
